gaps.lead: 'I'll finish the essay by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: I'm sure the tickets are expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: must be = I'm sure it is (deduction).

gaps.lead: They arrived late because the traffic was terrible.
gaps.sentence: The traffic was ___ they arrived late.

gaps.lead: He started playing golf at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ golf at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby/sport): took up golf.

gaps.lead: 'Could you pass the salt?' said my aunt to me.
gaps.explanation: Reported request: asked me to pass.

gaps.lead: He finally managed to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.
